# bintables/storage

> Where variables live: stack slots, parameters and globals.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/storage.pkg)

The compiler renders this package wherever a template asks for a
variable's `{addr}` (or `{operand}`), choosing the section by the kind of
variable, and once per global for `decl`. Each section is one memory
operand, used as `mov rax, {addr}` or `lea rax, {addr}`.

| section | for | placeholders |
|---|---|---|
| `local` | a local variable or top-level `let` | `{offset}` = 8·(slot + 1) |
| `param` | a function parameter | `{offset}` = 16 + 8·index (above the saved `rbp` and the return address) |
| `global` | a `global` | `{name}` |
| `decl` | reserving a global in the data section | `{name}` |

`{index}` (the slot or parameter number) is also available.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit local`

```nasm
[rbp-{offset}]
```

### `emit param`

```nasm
[rbp+{offset}]
```

### `emit global`

```nasm
[rel pk_g_{name}]
```

### `emit decl`

```nasm
pk_g_{name}: dq 0
```
